parameters.name: Programmed rate
parameters.explanation: The Kangaroo OMNI enteral pump has a feed delivery setting; intermittent feeding additionally uses a defined feed volume and schedule. Verify the intended regimen against the authorised nutrition plan. A programmed setting neither confirms tube placement nor proves actual delivery.

parameters.name: Volume delivered
parameters.explanation: Track the feed actually delivered against the nutrition plan, recording interruptions and discrepancies. A pump display alone does not establish tube position or prove that the prescribed nutrition reached the patient.

parameters.name: Occlusion alarm
parameters.explanation: The Kangaroo OMNI distinguishes interrupted feed supply from obstruction in the patient-side tubing and possible sensor faults. Assess the patient and check the authorised feeding pathway; do not force-flush a blocked tube or resume use when position is unconfirmed. Use trained assistance and the exact device instructions.

safety_concepts.text: Confirm the position of every nasogastric tube after placement and before each use by aspiration and pH-graded paper (with X-ray if necessary); local protocols address failed aspiration or invalid pH from acid suppression (NICE CG32; NHS alert).
Introducing fluids or medicines into the respiratory tract or pleura through a misplaced tube is a Never Event in England (NHS 2016 alert).
Keep the head of the bed raised unless contraindicated (SHEA 2022 essential practice).
A functioning feeding pump or an absence of alarms does not confirm gastric tube placement. Follow the approved position-confirmation pathway before use.

monitoring_concepts.text: Tube position and fixation, feed tolerance, aspiration signs, head-of-bed angle.

escalation_concepts.text: Do not start or continue feeding, medication administration or flushing through a tube whose position cannot be confirmed. If respiratory distress develops during feeding, stop delivery, assess the patient, summon emergency help as indicated and follow the unit's suspected aspiration and tube-position protocol.
